title: Great reminder app
body: It does the reminder well, and helped me focus on working my habits
author: Théodor

title: Tracking without overwhelming
body:
Great habit-tracking system that removes all the frustration of having to start over from zero. It takes the “2-day rule” even further by helping you see your habits in the long run. The app itself is really enjoyable, clean, neat, and easy to use. I totally recommend it!

I just wish I could sync between devices via iCloud, hopefully it’s coming in a future update 🤞
author: Jirayto
